title: Fourier coefficient of a convolution
statement: Let $f,g\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ and $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The vector Fourier coefficient of the convolution of $f$ and $g$ at $\gamma$ equals the product of their vector Fourier coefficients at $\gamma$.
